propositions: The backend interface specification in ADR 0035 §(d) is currently a prose sketch and must be pinned with concrete Protocol names and facade design to unblock Phase 2 implementation stories S2–S5.

The canonical ticket model must be rebar's local ticket (not a separate CanonicalTicket), with adapters translating vendor↔local via existing mappers (outbound_fields.py, inbound_fields.py, inbound_translate.py).

The backend interface shall be abstracted behind a single Backend facade exposing five mandatory role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) and optional capability Protocols (SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsIncremental).
A new RemoteRef type (vendor, instance, remote_id) must replace hardcoded "jira" literals and bare jira_key in apply_inbound_records.py as a unified identity tuple.
Three architectural leak-fixes must be documented: ADF-sizing removed from the differ, lossy-status/parent rules moved into the Jira adapter, and duplicated value-maps/link-constants single-sourced.
The ADR must scope the proof-of-seam (contract suite + FakeBackend test) to Phase 2 epic bbf1, deferring the real second backend (GitHub adapter) to epic be74.
